question: By what method should the reinstallation of the liṅga be performed?
premises: Reinstallation of the liṅga is required
A method for it has already been stated
That stated method must be followed
inference: One should perform the reinstallation of the liṅga exactly by the stated method.
plain_english: One should perform the reinstallation of the liṅga exactly according to the method already stated.
